about: D-SINK-110 (2026-11-16): one reading of provider text for the helper's sinks of free text and the notification body. The helper's shown_text (bin/helper/01-core.py; the player's window title and media title through player_title_text, log(), and main()'s traceback through shown_lines) and the model's Model.shownText (the notification body through notifyNameText and notifyReasonText) both run this fixture: tests/test_shown_text.py and tests/Model.test.js. The text is redacted as the guide row redacts it and every control character is removed AFTER the redaction; a control between a URL's scheme start and its first run character, as the text without its controls reads its URLs, is deleted before it, and every other control is read as U+0001. `py` is exactly what shown_text prints and `js` exactly what shownText prints (the helper keeps the scheme, as redaction-vectors.json says); `mustNotAppear` holds for both.
credentialsAreFake: Every credential here is synthetic (qqqqqq / zzzzzz, my.user / pw) on hosts under the reserved .test TLD.

sweep.about: Both suites build the same inputs: each source text below with one of `controls` inserted at every code point position, and each of `pairs.bases` with two of `pairs.controls` at every pair of positions (the first at or before the second). Each input's sink output -- the window title (player_title_text) in the helper, the notification reason (notifyReasonText) in the model -- is judged by the pieces it shows: a source's mustNotAppear entries that appear in it, or, for a source with none, its maximal runs of `q` or `z`, each compared with the controls and `[host withheld]` taken out. Three properties: (1) for a source with mustNotAppear, the output shows no entry the plain redaction of the source text itself withholds; (2) the output shows nothing the sinks' old reading -- the controls deleted, then the plain redaction -- withholds; (3) when every control in the input is one of `nonDelimiterControls` and stands outside every URL's scheme start to first run character as the text without its controls reads its URLs, the output shows nothing the plain redaction of the input withholds.
sweep.measured: 2026-11-16 on the dev tree with D-SINK-110: 102,834 one-control inputs and 37,188 pairs, 0 failing any property in either suite. On 1118ffb's sinks (the controls deleted before the redaction) property (3) fails; the counts are in QA-RESULTS (dev branch), section D-SINK-110.
